blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket holder won the jackpots in Super Lotto 6/49, Lotto 6/42 or 6D Lotto during the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Thursday, Oct. 22. According to the PCSO results provided, the Super Lotto 6/49 draw produced the winning combination 03-16-11-35-04-30, with a jackpot of ₱62.47 million. No bettor matched all six numbers. Lotto 6/42 also recorded no jackpot winner. The winning combination was 22-42-37-21-08-17, with a jackpot prize of ₱12.22 million. The 6D Lotto draw yielded the winning combination 1-4-8-6-6-1 for a jackpot of ₱1.79 million. No ticket holder won the top prize. READ: Lotto […]...
